slideDifferences.nativeText:
To Consider 
1. We need to pay attention to the tenses in order to make the structures work correctly. 
2. *GET sometimes is used to substituted HAVE to make very emphatic another subject makes the action. See example in row 2.

3. We can also used GET with participles. E.G. Get the clock fixed now!
     *Get + Adjectives can also be used here.
slideDifferences.publishedText: To Consider 1. We need to pay attention to the tenses in order to make the structures work correctly. 2. *GET sometimes is used to substitute HAVE to be very emphatic of making another subject do the action. slideDifferences.nativeText:
Working with these structures we can board some functions-
Functions
Examples
1
State things people do for others.
Jill had John call Mary to apologize.
I will have Annie finish this pie tonight.
2
Talk about things done in our behalf or for us.
The school had the hall painted by the students.
We will have the speech addressed by Joshua.
3
Give instructions
John, please, get it to work. We need the coffee maker.
To consider 
We need to remember that there are many other ways in which we can ask or have others do things for us.
slideDifferences.publishedText: Working with these structures we can have some functions. Functions Examples 1 State things people do for others Jill had John call Mary to apologize. I will have Annie finish this pie tonight. 2 Talk about things done in our behalf or for us The school had the hall painted by the students. We will have the speech addressed by Joshua. 3 Give instructions John, please, get it to work. We need the coffee maker. To consider We need to remember that there are many other ways in which we can ask or have others do things for us, like using modals to be polite: Could you please open this for me?

slideDifferences.nativeText:
B. Listen to the audio and answer the questions your teacher makes.
Do it yourself

It is very common to listen to people say: If you want to do something, do it yourself. Have others make chores or favors for / to you does not always end well. Get people to work or do things  the way you want has always been kind of a challenge. If we refer to a professional area, you need to have people trained so they know what you want and expect. On a more personal level, get others to know you and get to know them will make things easier in dealing with different situations that may present. Whatever it is, professional or personal, have others do things for us or get things done by others is something challenging.

Do it yourself

It is very common to listen to people say: If you want to do something, do it yourself. Have others make chores or favors for / to you does not always end well. Get people to work or do things  the way you want has always been kind of a challenge. If we refer to a professional area, you need to have people trained so they know what you want and expect. On a more personal level, get others to know you and get to know them will make things easier in dealing with different situations that may present. Whatever it is, professional or personal, have others do things for us or get things done by others is something challenging.
